title: (Not So) Casual
fandoms: Game Changers | Heated Rivalry - All Media Types
summary:
“-- and apparently there’s a type of sexual attraction where you have to get to know someone before you… notice them,” Shane continued, ignoring Ilya’s interruption. “But I don’t know if that applies to me, because I’ve never had any problems with sexual attraction to men.”
Ilya grinned wickedly. ‘Yes, you were turned gay –”
“You did not turn me gay, Ilya.”
“-- by the hottest man ever, so I do not blame you for not finding women sexy after sucking my cock for the first time.”
“Ilya,” Shane scolded, an amused smile dancing at the corners of his half hearted glare.
“Maybe you are not this thing…” Ilya trailed off.
“Demisexual,” Shane supplied.
"Yes, demisexual, with women,” Ilya nodded sagely. “Maybe you are just Rose-sexual.”
A startled laugh burst out of Shane, before he shook his head in amusement. “I’m not sure that it works that way, baby.”
“Hmm, but you would maybe like to try and find out?”
“Yeah, maybe.”
Or
Shane proposes a one-time threesome with Rose. And it goes really well, so there's no harm in making it a semi-occasional thing when their schedules align, right? After all, it's just a casual hookup.
